scientific_integrity: The stand-alone exact finite checks do not replace the symbolic proof; the third-party 2023 full journal article was inaccessible and this is recorded as an originality residual risk.
scientific_limitations: Exact fixed-parameter polynomial growth order only; no leading constant, no efficient-code complexity or uniformity in growing k; upper bound quoted from arXiv:2609.23106; publication priority and all-parameter proof have not had independent review.
title: Sharp polynomial growth of distinct \(k\)-decks for every alphabet and fixed read length
